name: Omacube
author: Tiedeyez
description: Your desktop as a 3x3 puzzle cube: an animated background of an endless isometric stack of cubes that turn and tumble with real physics. Here and there a giant solved cube rises out of the pile and spells OMARCHY in a sticker mosaic. Colours follow your Omarchy theme, and workspace switches slide the stack with your windows. An optional companion theme adds classic colours and cube-face tiling. One GPU fragment shader; no processes or network.
